name: instructions
description: Detailed guidelines outlining the main character's behavior, personality traits, and decision-making process within the game.

name: actions
description: Comprehensive list of all actions available to the character, including their effects and any prerequisites required to perform them.

name: logs
description: Chronological record of all actions executed by the character, including timestamps and the outcomes of each action.

name: game_info
description: Essential information about the game world, including the current location, time, and any relevant environmental factors affecting gameplay.

name: player_info
description: Key statistics and attributes of the player, rated on a scale of Critical, Very Low, Low, Normal, Good, or Very Good. 'Low' or 'Critical' indicates a need for improvement, while 'Good' signifies satisfactory performance.

name: inventory
description: Detailed list of items currently in the player's possession, including quantities and any special properties or uses.

name: objectives
description: List of primary and secondary goals the player must achieve to progress in the game, including any time constraints or special conditions.
